topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Hey, I just heard about, well, about the job thing. I’m not sure what to think, to be honest. I mean, I feel like there’s probably a reason, right? People don’t just, I don’t know, make stuff up. If you ever feel like talking about it, I’m here. I’m not going to pretend it’s not a big deal; it kind of is. But what’s more important is you. If something’s going on, if there’s something you need from me, you know I’m all ears. Just, take your time, okay? But don’t push yourself away over this. We’ve been through a lot, and I’m not going anywhere.
